known_blockers.description: Explorer-verified-source retrieval was not obtained for this deployment in this pass (see catalog-wide note below); identity above rests on Uniswap Labs' own deployments feed plus the on-chain fingerprint, which is strong but is not itself a byte-for-byte verified-source diff.

api.mantlescan.xyz getsourcecode requires a paid Etherscan-V2 API key (none provisioned); explorer.mantle.xyz returned 502 for the whole session; mantlescan.xyz's web UI returns 403 to scripted fetches; Sourcify (sourcify.dev) has no full/partial match for factory, pool_deployer or example_pool on chain 5000. Byte-exact source/commit pin for Agni's fork is therefore unconfirmed pending explorer/API access, a manual bytecode diff against a compiled PancakeSwap-v3-core build, or a direct response from the Agni team.

No authoritative Agni Finance documentation site with a contracts page was confirmed reachable in this pass (docs.agni.finance did not resolve; the top hit for an "agni" GitBook space, agni.gitbook.io, is an empty placeholder "First Workspace" unrelated to the protocol). The addresses above rest on independent on-chain discovery (a live Agni-labeled pool from GeckoTerminal's dex listing, then pool.factory()/factory.poolDeployer() round-trips) rather than a project-published contracts page.

Same explorer/API access gap as agni_v3_explorer_source (mantlescan keyed-API/403, explorer.mantle.xyz 502, no Sourcify match). Byte-exact commit pin for FusionX's fork is unconfirmed despite the strong address corroboration above.

No candidate upstream repository has been matched to the on-chain MoeFactory/MoePair bytecode (solc 0.8.20, EIP-1167-style minimal-proxy clones). lfj-gg/joe-core is confirmed NOT a match (see confidence_basis). Explorer-verified-source retrieval is also blocked (same mantlescan keyed-API/403 and explorer.mantle.xyz 502 issues as the v3 sources). Until a source is matched or the Merchant Moe team responds, Moe Classic's swap math must not be migrated from an assumed reference — I07 needs either (a) explorer/API access, (b) a direct source from the Merchant Moe team, or (c) narrow independent differential fixtures (fixed-block quoter/simulation-only admission) that do not depend on matching a Solidity source file, per DESIGN §2.3's "otherwise a fork simulation" fallback. Recorded as a hard blocker, not a generic-AMM substitute.

Same explorer/API access gap as the v3 sources (no getsourcecode key, explorer.mantle.xyz down, no Sourcify match). The joe-v2@v2.2.0 match above is from independent behavioral/metadata fingerprinting, not an explorer source diff; I08 should still obtain one if access becomes available, to catch any Merchant-Moe-specific patch on top of v2.2.0.
